description: An easy trail with two loops to choose from. The trail winds up and down through ponds, creeks and areas of old growth, second growth and regenerating forests. This is a popular trail for families and school groups and provides some great forest interpretation along the way.
directions: Heading north on Highway 19 past the Port McNeill junction, turn left onto the highway leading to Port Alice. A short distance down the road will lead to Beaver Lake Day Use Site on the right and the short road on the left will take you to the Beaver Lake Trail head parking lot.

stats.Activity Details: Wildlife Viewing, Picnicking, Viewing, Nature Study, Hiking

title: Beaver Lake
